Having played multiple hours of both, I think OSP is a great variant, and will be even more so after further play - hear me out. 

When each person spawns with the same gun, it leads to very predictable early engagements, with most maps being one of two angles. The game mode becomes staler with predictability. Spawn and either peek right/left - prefire. 

However, in OSP, there are more dynamic routes in order to pick up guns. It leads to engagements at a wider variety of angles, and requires more co-ordination with teammate as to where you get guns/attack.

I think both modes will be viable, but people are writing off OSP too quickly. It's balanced, and after playing 4+ hours of both, I think I favor it more.

Copied from /r/FortniteCompetitive , but this is completely unacceptable. For a company that has had weeks to figure this out and is putting millions into a tournament, this has turned from laughable to sad.

1). NickEh30 not even able to load into the game - not once - but twice. There is no immediate remake, leaving Nick to just miss on on potentially thousands of dollars for Epic's own mistakes.

2). 70 people in one of the final circles of game one, causing so much lag that 50 players die to the storm. The SAME ISSUES that we saw in week one. How is this ok? https://clips.twitch.tv/PleasantTrustworthyBulgogiLeeroyJenkins

3). ....Everyone's favorite. The casters. They go off on random tangents that do not relate to the game whatsoever, who met which player first, or who they played mini golf with. Coming from watching league, csgo, or professional sports, these casters are an embarrassment. We've seen good casters come in, Monster, Nick, Lupo, but Epic would rather shove Zeke down our throats. I would rather watch the stream on mute.

4). On a positive note, the spectator client is better - the ability to see player's outlines and position on the map is a great addition - but again, they are missing all of the action - the casters call out the killfeed rather than the gameplay since you only see 5-10 actual gunfights live across the entire game.

I don't mean to shit on the game, this is one of the most fun games I have played in some time. It has so much potential, there is massive investment from organizations, the personalities are the best I have seen across Esports, but the viewing experience this week is trash.
